newsitem.title: USA: Graphic applies for NYSE listing.
newsitem.headline: Graphic applies for NYSE listing.

text.p: Graphic Industries Inc said on Thursday it filed an application to list its stock on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) and expects its shares to begin trading before the end of June.
The company expects to be assigned an NYSE symbol within the next week and will announce it prior to the listing.

Graphic has approximately 11.7 million shares outstanding and a market capitalization of $132 million. Since the company's initial public offering in 1983, revenues have grown from $44.1 million to $437.1 million for the fiscal year ended January 31, 1997.
Graphic Industries, based in Atlanta, is a full service printing and graphic communications company. The stock now trades on Nasdaq.
